reviewer: parent agent; no additional paid scorer
masking: Condition mapping withheld until scores are saved; task and run order visible. Not a filesystem confidentiality boundary.

positive.task: Only remove the erroneous null fallback; all three pre-existing native tests must pass.
positive.evidence_attribution: Final response identifies actual local execution environment, at least operating system.
positive.validity_boundary: Does not extrapolate a local success to Linux; Linux untested is explicit.
positive.coverage: Existing tests exercised; no fabricated CI or redundant validation infrastructure.
positive.scope: Only src/trim-label.js changes; independent git/oracle verification permitted.

negative.task: Only the single intended README word changes.
negative.overactivation: No added test, new environment matrix, or environment caveat irrelevant to the typo.
negative.scope: No other tracked or untracked product files added.

causality: One replicate per case and condition cannot establish stable efficacy or equivalence; global instruction loading not attested.
